blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Bennie Boatwright moved closer to completing his naturalization status that will pave the way for his long-awaited Gilas Pilipinas debut after taking an oath of allegiance on Wednesday. Labor secretary Francis Tolentino posted on social media a photo of Boatwright taking the oath at the Philippine consulate in China where he is in the latest stop of his professional career.
